text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Win!! I'll win――against Oguri-san!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguriiiin!! Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan C
text_block_list.text: Win this, Oguri! Gwooooo for it!!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (She's accelerating?! From here——?!)
(Waaaaaaahhhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I thought Oguri had lost her edge... and 
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Did she accelerate again... in front of 
the grandstands?)

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ogurin... Ogurin, you were amazing!! You 
were sooooo cool!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
That final stretch was electric, as 
always! I'll be looking forward to your 
next race!
(WAAAH! WAAAAAAAH!)

Even after the race ended, Oguri Cap's 
name echoed from the stands, and the 
cheering showed no sign of stopping...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that as I am now... I would be 
able to surpass Oguri-san, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The one the crowd was praising after the 
race was Oguri-san...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Why...?! Why wasn't I able to reach the 
same level as Oguri-san...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What is the difference between Oguri-san 
and me...? What am I missing!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono, where do you believe 
Oguri-san's true greatness lies?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Why does her running captivate people's 
hearts so much...!

The reason Oguri Cap receives such 
support. Setting aside her background, 
when I think about her running...
choice_data_list:
It felt like I completely burned out and 
then came back from it.

text_block_list.text:
Even after giving it her absolute all, 
Oguri Cap is capable of accelerating once 
more.

I told her that there were moments when 
her acceleration felt as if her fighting 
spirit had been revived, completely 
captivating my gaze.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed... Oguri-san accelerated again 
in front of the grandstand today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the Mainichi Hai was 
also...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(—I've got this! None stand before me 
now!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan
text_block_list.text:
OGUUUUURIII!! Don't lose! Give it 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...A comeback right in front of the 
grandstands...

From the audience's perspective, it looked 
as if their cheers had reignited Oguri 
Cap's fighting spirit, giving them the 
feeling that she had answered their calls.

"—No, couldn't the same be said from Oguri 
Cap's side as well...?"
choice_data_list:
Is she accelerating when she hears the 
cheers...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Exactly so! It was right after the 
cheers erupted!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Eh...? Does that mean...
choice_data_list:
Oguri Cap draws strength from everyone's 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —...Come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I was quite surprised. To think 
that entire mountain of boxes was all fan 
presents."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It seems they sent it after finding out 
about my injury.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so happy. It really cheers me up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheering always gives me 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san said so herself. 'The cheers 
give me strength'...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san is... turning the cheers of the 
crowd into her own strength...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...If that's the truth... and the cheers 
just keep on growing like this...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Just how much power does Oguri-san 
have...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Am I simply no match for Oguri-san...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even if she gains “obsession,” to think 
she could bridge this overwhelming gap...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...If only I had a weapon...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If only I had a weapon like the cheers 
that Oguri-san has...

—If it's a weapon you need, one does come 
to mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I... I wiiiiiill... Aaaaagh, I willlll!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm the strongest of allllll! 
Oraaaaaaaaahh!!

If Yaeno Muteki can unleash the kind of 
bottomless power she showed in the Nippon 
Derby—

If I burn myself up with "obsession" and 
run with raw emotion just like back 
then... there might be a chance.

In my opinion, the core of Yaeno Muteki's 
running lies in her fighting spirit. 
Stoking those flames will obviously help 
her unleash her true potential.

However, on the other hand, letting out 
too much fighting spirit leads to losing 
control. That is why she has maintained 
control through "Unifying Fire and Water," 
honing its perfection.

Since attaining “obsession,” she's been 
able to show more fighting spirit than 
before, but... releasing it completely all 
at once might be a stretch...

It carries the risk of losing control of 
emotions and running wild.

—She may not realize it herself, but 
today, Yaeno Muteki seemed to find it very 
easy to run. Owing to the sheer width of 
Tokyo Racecourse.

She likely runs while remaining acutely 
aware of the Umamusume around her. Perhaps 
having more open space gives her greater 
peace of mind.

She always took the utmost care to keep 
from running wild, so I hesitated to 
suggest unleashing her fighting spirit 
completely in battle.

"The chances of victory might increase. 
However, the risk of running wild is 
high."

If she loses control, she might never be 
able to rein it in again, and there's a 
risk her running form will fall apart 
entirely.

Could this situation be what Yaeno Muteki 
fears the most?

...I really can't adopt that approach 
after all.
choice_data_list:
Nothing comes to mind right now, but let's 
think it through together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. If a surefire path to 
victory were so easy to find, no one would 
ever struggle...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Progress step by step, day by day. There 
is only training.

Even if the road ahead is steep and devoid 
of light, someone who can maintain steady 
effort like her should have the grit to 
surpass Oguri Cap.

For now, all I can do is believe and push 
forward――

On the way home, it suddenly occurred to 
me that we hadn't decided on our next 
target race yet.
choice_data_list: By the way, about the next race...

text_block_list.text:
Fully aware that running consecutive races 
would be pushing it, I suggest entering 
the Takarazuka Kinen.

I want to defeat the strong and win over 
the crowd's hearts. Keeping her goal in 
mind, I asked if she wanted to enter the 
Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, just as you say. The Grand Prix is a 
prime opportunity where the strongest 
gather. I would very much like to run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Who else could there be...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san, City-san... Ah, it looks like 
Inari-san is running too.

Inari One—an Umamusume who built a 
glittering track record in Oi races.

In the Central, with a run in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring) that showcased her potential, 
she is already earning high praise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The emergence of a new powerhouse... In 
the racing world, that is a welcome sight.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the past continues to drift 
further and further away...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yet, to prevent the past from simply being 
the past, I continue to run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"At the Takarazuka Kinen, I will awaken 
the past!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

Yaeno Muteki's battle cry roars into the 
crimson sky. Did that sharp, taut 
atmosphere inspire me, or was it herself—
